parsed.post: Kept the LR 0.1 and warmup 0.1. val_bpb improved from 1.095471 to 1.094229. Next: I'll try reducing the batch size to 262144 to see if more gradient updates per epoch help, while keeping the current LR/warmup settings.
parsed.description: Reducing batch size to 262144 to increase the number of optimization steps, while maintaining the current MATRIX_LR=0.1 and WARMUP_RATIO=0.1.
